saved: Specifications saved. New slots will use these settings.
description: Default runtime type and hardware for new slots. Memory, vCPU and disk can be customized per slot at creation; existing slots are unaffected.
runtimeHelp: Preselected when opening Import or Quick create. Falls back to a container if the host does not support KVM.
dockerHelp: Shares the host kernel and starts in seconds. Uses only the memory setting below.
kvmHelp: Uses a separate kernel and all hardware fingerprints below. Requires /dev/kvm on the host.
resourceHelp: Memory applies to both runtime types; vCPU and disk apply only to virtual machines.
lowMemory: Below 1 GB: running the resident CLI alongside initial installation may cause an out-of-memory failure.
memoryHelp: Container memory limit or virtual machine memory.
fingerprintHelp: Applies only to virtual machines. Sets the guest CPU model and DMI; serial numbers, UUIDs, the last three MAC bytes and disk serial numbers are randomized per slot.
cpuHelp: host passes through the host CPU unchanged; software emulation treats it as max.
macHelp: Three hexadecimal bytes; the multicast bit must be 0.
tcgHelp: Runs VMs in QEMU software emulation when the host lacks /dev/kvm. Booting takes several minutes; for testing only.
hardwareAcceleration: /dev/kvm is available. VMs use hardware acceleration.
tcgAvailable: No /dev/kvm. TCG software emulation is enabled.
containersOnly: No /dev/kvm. Only containers can be created.
clusterPreflight: Cluster nodes are checked separately at creation.
previewHelp: Preview dmidecode and network adapters using the current draft.
diskRange: {{min}}–{{max}} GB. Additional capacity does not preallocate host storage.
